issues.on_page: Line 18 Local Receipts: Other, General Fund 90,404.00
issues.issue: This one unexplained line is 58% of governmental receipts excluding transfers (90,404 of 155,810). It is recorded as 'other' with review. Under the extractor rules, an unexplained line that is most of the year's receipts belongs in decision_needed (what is it: fees, grants, loan proceeds?).
The extractor assumed these are utility charges. That is plausible for an enterprise fund, but nothing in the PDF says so. Already marked review.
